findings.message: Login route '(unnamed)' (POST login) has no throttle middleware — brute-force attacks unmitigated. Add ->middleware('throttle:5,1').
Login route 'login' (GET login) has no throttle middleware — brute-force attacks unmitigated. Add ->middleware('throttle:5,1').
User model in app/Models/User.php doesn't appear to mark 'password' as hidden or use the 'hashed' cast — verify password storage is hashed and not exposed in API responses.
Registration route register has no throttle middleware — automated signups unmitigated. Add ->middleware('throttle:5,1').
Email verification route 'verification.notice' (verify-email) is missing 'signed' middleware — URL parameters can be tampered with.
APP_ENV is 'local' — leaks development-mode behavior in production.
app.debug_blacklist is empty — Whoops debug pages will expose all env, server and request data when an exception fires.
Keys present in .env but missing from .env.example: DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_DATABASE, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD, CACHE_PREFIX
session.encrypt is false — session payloads (including flash data and CSRF tokens) are stored in plaintext on the session driver.
SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE is false — sessions cookies will be sent over HTTP and can be hijacked on shared networks.
Weak generator (Str::random/md5/sha1/uniqid/random_bytes/bin2hex) used near a password symbol — use Str::password() for app-generated passwords.
Weak random function 'uniqid' — not cryptographically secure. Use random_bytes(), random_int(), or Str::random() for security-sensitive tokens.
fast-uri 3.0.0 - 3.1.6 — fast-uri vulnerable to authority injection via an unvalidated port in serialize
nanoid <3.3.18 — nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero
`unlink()` deletes filesystem entries — verify path is not user-controlled.
No HSTS middleware detected in the HTTP kernel — Strict-Transport-Security header is essential for HTTPS-only deployments.
No Referrer-Policy middleware detected — set a Referrer-Policy header to control referrer information leakage.
No X-Content-Type-Options middleware detected — without nosniff, browsers may MIME-sniff responses and execute untrusted content.
No X-Frame-Options middleware detected — without it, your application may be vulnerable to clickjacking attacks.
app.url is not set or points to localhost — host header injection can redirect users, set cookies, generate signed URLs, and poison password reset emails.
Custom error page resources/views/errors/500.blade.php is missing — default Laravel error pages may leak Whoops debug info.
Custom error page resources/views/errors/503.blade.php is missing — default Laravel error pages may leak Whoops debug info.
